dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000s7cl](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000s7cl) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 19.954 depth occurred on Feb 08 2026 2 km NW of Santo Tomás Tamazulapam, Mexico. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 16.2912 longitude -96.6001. It impacted 146094 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
